serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
After walking for 15 minutes or so, a voice from the cellphone told me to drop the ‘package’ into a storm drain.
I caught a glimpse of a moving shadow through the grate. 
Someone was waiting there and as soon as I dropped it the gun was picked up probably by another crazy person.
Once again I helped these people…
I know what Big Daddy told me, that this is for greater good, that I need to stay on the inside, but how far is too far for him? 
Maybe I don’t know Big Daddy that well after all…
